title: Our Nation — Symbols, Laws, and Freedom Quiz
description: Test your knowledge about America's symbols, laws, and freedoms!

questions.question: How many stars are on the American flag?
questions.explanation: There are 50 stars on the American flag, one for each of the 50 states in our country.

questions.question: What is America's national bird?
questions.explanation: The bald eagle is America's national bird. It was chosen because it is strong, brave, and free.

questions.question: What Bible verse is written on the Liberty Bell?
options: Leviticus 25:10 — 'Proclaim liberty throughout all the land'
questions.explanation: The Liberty Bell has 'Proclaim liberty throughout all the land' from Leviticus 25:10 written on it.

questions.question: What does 'one nation under God' in the Pledge of Allegiance mean?
options: America was founded on trust in God
questions.explanation: 'One nation under God' means that America was founded on trust in God and that we look to Him for guidance.

questions.question: Why do we have laws?
options: To keep us safe and treat everyone fairly
questions.explanation: Laws help keep us safe and make sure everyone is treated fairly. Many of our laws are based on God's commandments.

questions.question: What is freedom of religion?
options: Everyone must go to the same church
We can worship God however we choose
Only adults can go to church
questions.explanation: Freedom of religion means we can worship God however we choose. No one can tell us we cannot pray or read our Bible.

questions.question: Where do our rights and freedoms come from, according to the Founders?
questions.explanation: Our Founding Fathers believed that our rights and freedoms come from God, not from any government or king.

questions.question: What does Micah 6:8 say the Lord requires of us?
options: To act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God
questions.explanation: Micah 6:8 tells us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with God — which is what good citizens do!
